{"metadata":{"description":"Trae-style withdraw for DeepSeek Harness Web — one-click rollback of workspace code + conversation (git commits or hard-link snapshots). 会话撤回插件","id":"gh:1334851624","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-rollback-withdraw","slug":"dyhyfjn/dsh-rollback-withdraw","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","rollback","withdraw"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Trae-style withdraw for DeepSeek Harness Web — one-click rollback of workspace code + conversation ("},{"id":"p1s2","text":"git commits or hard-link snapshots). 会话撤回插件"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-rollback-withdraw"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Trae-style withdraw for DeepSeek Harness Web.** A one-click rollback button on every user question"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" and assistant answer that rewinds both the **workspace code** and the **conversation itself** (memo"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ry, trajectory, goals) to the state before that message."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"简体中文 · English"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Every completed turn in a DSH web session becomes a *rollback point*. Click the undo icon next to an"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"y message and the workspace files are restored to the last completed turn before it, while the sessi"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"on is forked at that point and the rolled-back conversation opens automatically — exactly as if that"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" exchange never happened."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Workspace code** — restored via the best available backend (see below).
- **Conversation** — the"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" session is forked at the boundary and the child (rolled-back) session is opened; model memory, traj"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ectory, goals and subagent lineage all match that point in time.
- **First-class git integration** —"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" when the workspace is a git repository, checkpoints are real commits, and a withdraw is a `git rese"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"t --hard` + a safe `git clean`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Withdraw on every message** — under every user bubble and on the final assistant message of each"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" completed turn.
- **Two restore backends, chosen automatically:**
- **Git mode** (default on, one-c"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"lick toggle): every turn end is committed as `rollback checkpoint <seq>`; a withdraw restores via `g"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"it reset --hard` + `git clean` that preserves dependency/build directories. Space-efficient and alig"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ned with normal git workflows.
- **File-snapshot mode**: otherwise, hard-link snapshots are taken at"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" every turn end — unchanged files share a single copy across snapshots, so keeping hundreds of turns"},{"id":"p9s7","text":" costs almost nothing.
- **Per-workspace toggle** — the git-branch icon in the session header turns "},{"id":"p9s8","text":"git auto-commit on/off; the choice persists in `.dsh-rollback/config.json`.
- **Loads automatically*"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"* — packaged as a web-profile bundle (`dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`), it starts with the client; no re"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"-activation after restarts.
- **Two-step confirm** — click once to arm (button turns red), click aga"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"in to execute, so a rollback is never accidental."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Item | Notes |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| OS | Windows (uses `robocopy` + PowerShell 5.1+); other platforms planned |
| Git | optional — onl"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"y needed for git mode |
| DSH | web profile (`dsh web`) |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Restart the web app afterwards — plugin-set changes take effect on restart."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. Chat with the agent as usual; a rollback point is recorded automatically after every completed tu"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"rn.
2. Hover a message and click the **undo icon** — click once to arm ("confirm"), click again to e"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"xecute.
3. The workspace is restored and the UI switches to the forked, rolled-back session. Continu"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"e workspace is restored and the UI switches to the forked, rolled-back session. Continue from there."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The **git-branch icon** in the session header shows git-mode status:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- lit (brand color + green dot) = git auto-commit **on**;
- dimmed = **off**, or the workspace is no"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"t a git repository (tooltip explains);
- disabled when the workspace has no git repo."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- The host half listens to `session/event` and records a checkpoint at every `turn/end` — a git comm"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"it, or a hard-link snapshot under `<workspace>/.dsh-rollback/snap/<session>/<seq>/`.
- Client button"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"s talk to the host through a same-origin HTTP route `/rollback/rpc` (the static-plugin channel that "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"replaces the dynamic `harness.handle`).
- A withdraw validates the boundary (the last `turn/end` bef"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ore the message), restores the files, then the client forks the session at that sequence and opens t"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"he child.
- The first message of a session cannot be withdrawn (there is no prior turn); messages fr"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"om before the plugin was installed have no snapshot — the button explains why."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Key | Where | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| `gitAutoCommit` | `<workspace>/.dsh-rollback/config.json` | `true` | use git commits as rollback p"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"oints when the workspace is a git repo |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Ignored paths (never snapshotted, committed, or deleted): `node_modules`, `.git`, `dist`, `build`, `"},{"id":"p25s2","text":".next`, `.venv`, `__pycache__`, `.idea`, `.vscode`, `coverage`, `*.pyc`, `*.log`, … (see `IGNORE_DIR"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"S` / `IGNORE_FILES` in `lib/index.js`)."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Security note"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"`/rollback/rpc` is a same-origin, unauthenticated route on the localhost web server — this tool assu"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"mes personal, localhost-only usage. Do not expose the harness port to untrusted networks."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- Windows first (robocopy + PowerShell); macOS/Linux fallbacks are planned.
- Git mode performs a wh"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ole-repository `git reset --hard` + `git clean` (ignored directories preserved) — untracked non-igno"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"red files are deleted on rollback.
- Withdrawing an assistant answer also rewinds the preceding ques"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"tion (rollback returns to the last completed turn end); the platform's fork primitive only cuts at t"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"urn boundaries.
- The source session stays in the sidebar as a branch; there is no auto-archive."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"MIT — see LICENSE."}],"truncated":false}
